# owner: platform
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student

# ---
def build_absence_notice(
    student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]
) -> str:
    """Short notice listing the days a student was absent.

    Raises ValueError if any mark belongs to another student
    or if the marks hold no absences.
    """
    all_marks = list(marks)
    for mark in all_marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ValueError(
                f"mark for {mark.student_id} does not "
                f"belong to {student.student_id}"
            )
    absent = [
        mark.day for mark in all_marks
        if mark.status == "absent"
    ]
    days = sorted(set(absent))
    if not days:
        raise ValueError("no absences to write about")
    count = len(days)
    unit = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    lines = [f"- {day.isoformat()}" for day in days]
    dates = "\n".join(lines)
    return (
        f"Dear parent or guardian,\n\n"
        f"{name} missed {count} {unit} of school:\n"
        f"{dates}\n"
    )

# owner: platform
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import build_absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")


def make_mark(day, status, who="s1"):
    return Mark(who, date(2026, 10, day), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_names_student_count_and_dates_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            make_mark(9, "absent"),
            make_mark(5, "present"),
            make_mark(2, "absent"),
        ]
        text = build_absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("Ada Lovelace missed 2 days", text)
        first = text.index("2026-10-02")
        second = text.index("2026-10-09")
        self.assertLess(first, second)
        self.assertNotIn("2026-10-05", text)

    def test_single_day_is_singular(self):
        text = build_absence_notice(
            PUPIL, [make_mark(3, "absent")]
        )
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day ", text)

    def test_repeated_day_counts_once(self):
        marks = [make_mark(3, "absent")] * 2
        text = build_absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day ", text)

    def test_other_students_mark_is_rejected(self):
        marks = [
            make_mark(3, "absent"),
            make_mark(4, "absent", who="s2"),
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_absences_is_rejected(self):
        marks = [
            make_mark(3, "late"),
            make_mark(4, "excused"),
        ]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)

    def test_no_marks_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            build_absence_notice(PUPIL, [])
